from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action, charge, or legal dispute category stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The general legal classification of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
